text:
maria: FYI reproducible bug in sample-app onboarding flow. When token refresh fails the UI shows a generic modal: `Request failed` and nothing actionable. Logs:

```
Error: Request failed
  at HttpClient.request (sdk/lib/http.ts:142)
  at Auth.refreshToken (sample-app/auth.ts:67)
  status: 401
  body: {"error":"invalid_grant"}
```

kevin: ugh. Do we have a standardized error envelope from the SDK at all? or is sample-app just surfacing raw throws?

maria: sample-app just displays `err.message`. The JS SDK currently throws `Error` with no structured fields in this path.

jonathan: that's going to be a support pain. We need typed exceptions so apps can react (refresh token, show permissions UI, bubble up to Sentry with structured tags).

alex: proposing a minimal cross-sdk contract we can implement quickly. Suggest the SDK surface `RedwoodError` objects with these fields (TS example):

```
interface RedwoodError {
  name: string;             // e.g. "AuthError", "RateLimitError", "ServerError"
  status: number;           // HTTP status if available
  code?: string;            // stable machine-readable code (e.g. "auth.invalid_grant")
  message: string;          // human message
  retryable: boolean;       // whether caller should retry
  retryAfter?: number;      // seconds to wait if provided (from Retry-After)
  hint?: string;            // short UX hint for developers / users
}
```

sophie: need parity: Py/TS/Go should expose the same logical fields (names can be idiomatic). Also add `retryable` semantics so the higher-level client libs can implement backoff helpers.

kevin: mapping proposal:
- 401 -> AuthError, retryable=false, hint="refresh credentials"
- 403 -> PermissionError, retryable=false
- 429 -> RateLimitError, retryable=true, retryAfter from header if present
- 500/502/503 -> ServerError, retryable=true (exponential backoff)
- 400 with validation -> ValidationError, retryable=false

jonathan: agree with semantics. Edge: some 401s are transient during short clock skew — can we add an optional `transient` flag? or keep it simple and let callers decide.

alex: prefer single boolean `retryable` and clear hints. If we need finer grain later we can extend. Also let's include `code` so callers can special-case e.g. `auth.refresh_failed`.

maria: for the sample-app immediate fix I'll catch `RedwoodError` and show targeted UI:
- if name=="AuthError" show token refresh modal
- if name=="RateLimitError" show a throttled toast with countdown (use retryAfter)

kevin: workplan: alex drafts TS SDK PR to add `RedwoodError` class and mapping layer, plus small adapter in sample-app. Sophie to coordinate Py SDK and a short spec doc for parity. Jonathan will validate infra / gateway preserves Retry-After header for 429.

alex: I'll open a draft PR today. basic tests: map synthetic responses -> RedwoodError fields; add changelog entry and migration note for apps that previously did `err.message`.

sophie: I'll add an item to the SDK parity checklist and ping the other SDK owners. We should include a short example snippet in docs showing `if (err.retryable) { backoff.retry(...) }` and `if (err.name=="AuthError") { promptRefresh() }`.

maria: thanks. small UX note: error message strings should be helpful but not leak internal details. `hint` field is great for user-facing guidance.

kevin: once PR is up we'll do a quick devex review and tag for a minor semver bump. target: merge next Wednesday.

deploy-bot: CI: build 3129 passed :white_check_mark:

alex: :thumbsup: I'll post the PR link in this thread when ready and add smoke tests for sample-app.

maria: awesome — this should cut a lot of support tickets. :pray:

ACTION_ITEMS: [alex -> TS SDK PR + tests], [sophie -> parity doc + notify Py/Go], [jonathan -> confirm Retry-After path through gateway], [maria -> sample-app catch and UX patch]
